name: Calcium Sulphate (CaSO4·2H2O, Gypsum)
description: Calcium source (gypsum) that raises GH without raising KH. Sparingly soluble: CaSO4·2H2O is ~23.3% Ca by mass, so 2 g in 100 L adds ~4.7 ppm Ca (disclosed stoichiometry). The associated GH rise is small (~0.65 dGH) and stated qualitatively via `affects` rather than overstated here.
notes: Dissolve slowly / pre-mix — gypsum is only sparingly soluble. Pairs with MgSO4 to build GH in soft / RO water without touching KH.
